root_cause: The private DNS zone privatelink.eastus.azmk8s.io that backs the cluster's private API FQDN is linked only to the AKS VNet (vnet-aks-spoke); it is not linked to vnet-hub, so the hub DNS resolver cannot resolve the FQDN and kubectl from the jumpbox fails with 'no such host'.
evidence: kubectl-error.txt: lookup of the private FQDN on 10.20.0.4:53 returns no such host
nslookup-from-jumpbox.txt: NXDOMAIN for the private API FQDN while a public name resolves through the same hub resolver
az-network-private-dns-link-list.json: zone privatelink.eastus.azmk8s.io has a single virtual network link, vnet-aks-spoke-link, pointing only at vnet-aks-spoke
az-network-vnet-peering-list.json: peering to vnet-hub is Connected (red herring — routing is not the problem)
fix: Create a virtual network link for the privatelink.eastus.azmk8s.io zone to vnet-hub so the jumpbox resolver can resolve the private API FQDN.
